note: First-floor attic of the B61 half-timbered repair café, under the steep dark-oak roof: dove-grey painted planks, wide honey floorboards, cool light from the round window. LANDMARK: the big round window framed like a gear wheel. The staircase coming up through the floor at the left goes back DOWN to the café, the way back; the open doorway at the back right leads on into the robot workshop. Adjectives have no gender (divider null). Zoom: the wooden market crate in the middle (z1, under the muddy buoy).
